credits.name: Credits
credits.description: Money: pays for buildings, crews and gifts.

alloys.name: Alloys
alloys.description: Refined metals: the main cost of ships and stations.

research.name: Research
research.description: Flows into the current technology each turn (not stockpiled).

volatiles.name: Volatiles
volatiles.description: Water ice, helium-3 and other light elements: air and water for colonies, fuel for advanced drives.
volatiles.found: ice moons, gas giants, arctic and ocean worlds, icy asteroids
volatiles.extracted_by: a Gas Refinery, an Ice Mine, a Mining Base on an icy asteroid, or a colony on its own world

rare_elements.name: Rare Elements
rare_elements.description: Heavy and rare-earth metals for armour, sensors and big guns.
rare_elements.found: volcanic worlds, asteroid belts, some barren rocks and desert worlds
rare_elements.extracted_by: a Mining Base (or a colony on its own world)

exotic_matter.name: Exotic Matter
exotic_matter.description: Matter with negative energy density, found in a handful of strange places. It bends space: hyperdrives and the greatest wonders need it.
exotic_matter.found: very rarely: anomalous moons and rocks, deep pockets of the belt (in your home system, in one place only)
exotic_matter.extracted_by: an Exotic Containment (research Exotic Physics first)
